feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 8 September 2026 6:24am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

West 5 or 6, veering West or NW this evening and increasing occasionally 7, then becoming generally NW 5 or 6 later tonight.


##State of sea)##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough in places later today and at first tonight.


##Weather)##

Scattered showers.


##Visibility)##

Good, possibly moderate in showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C

Fair.


##Visibility)##

Good.

16°C
